extracted.subtask_description: Contemporary newspaper dispatches and battlefield reports about World War II operations (Pacific and European theaters), including an official military proclamation to occupied island inhabitants. Aimed at informing the civilian public about military actions, casualties, proclamations, and political developments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establishment of military government
rubrics_metrics.description: All powers of government and jurisdiction in the occupied territory and over inhabitants therein, and final administrative responsibility are vested in me as Admiral, USN, commanding the United States forces of occupation and Military Governor, and will be exercised through subordinate commanders by my direction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Declared necessity: 'In order to preserve law and order and provide for the safety and welfare of both my forces and of yourselves, it is necessary to establish a military government in the islands occupied by United States forces.' Final administrative responsibility rests with the Military Governor and is delegated through subordinate commanders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Policy toward civilian inhabitants
rubrics_metrics.description: It is the policy of United States forces not to make war upon civilian inhabitants of these islands but to permit them to continue their normal lives and occupations in a peaceable manner so far as war necessities and their own behavior permit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Civilians should be allowed to continue normal life and occupations except where war necessities or their behavior require otherwise; reflects an intent to minimize harm to noncombatants under occupation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Suspension of Emperor of Japan's powers
rubrics_metrics.description: Exercise of the powers of the Emperor of Japan shall be suspended during the period of military occupation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All imperial authority in the occupied territory is suspended for the occupation period, transferring practical authority to the occupying military government.

rubrics_metrics.name: Obligation to obey orders and prohibition on hostile acts
rubrics_metrics.description: All persons will obey promptly all orders given by me or under my authority; must not commit acts hostile to United States forces under my command or in any way helpful to the Japanese; must not commit acts of violence or any act which may disturb the public safety in any way.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Residents are required to comply promptly with military orders; prohibition covers collaboration with enemy, violence, and actions disrupting public safety. Noncompliance would justify enforcement measures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Respect for existing personal and property rights; continuity of laws and customs
rubrics_metrics.description: Existing personal and property rights will be respected and your existing laws and customs remain in force and effect except to the extent that it is necessary ... to change (for the exercise of powers and duties).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Occupation will, as a rule, preserve local property rights, laws, and customs; changes will only be made when necessary for occupation administration or military necessity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Currency and legal tender rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Until further notice ... United States coins will be legal tender in the occupied territory and all persons are warned against accepting or declining any other currency whatever except as permitted under my orders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monetary control is asserted by declaring U.S. coins legal tender and warning against the use or acceptance of other currencies unless specifically authorized by military orders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limited interference if peaceable compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: So long as you remain peaceable and comply with orders of the United States forces of occupation you will be subject to no greater interference than is made necessary by war conditions and may go about your normal occupations without fear.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Promise of minimal interference contingent on peaceable conduct and compliance; provides reassurance to inhabitants while conditioning it on behavior.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication and dissemination of proclamations and orders
rubrics_metrics.description: Further proclamations and orders will be issued by me or under my authority from time to time and will be displayed at police stations and in your villages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Establishes procedure for publicizing occupation directives—orders will be regularly issued and posted at local stations/villages to inform inhabitants of requirements and changes.
